prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in round 5 where the effect was underpredicted.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sync Reminder Hint: Add an explicit reminder hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to use their original authentication method so their pet data is preserved. (why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Movement Animation Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated animation preview screen after photo upload so users can preview how their custom pet moves before waiting for final generation. (why: Adoption step conversion is low at 60.9% with a long mean duration of 1017s, and 3 support emails reported issues with custom pet appearance.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Progress Bar: Enable visual progress indicator and estimated remaining time on the waiting screen during pet engine startup. (why: Home step wait time has a high median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon or suspect the app has stalled.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Split View Photo Upload Layout: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a split view layout with photo picker controls on the left and a companion preview frame on the right. (why: Adoption is a bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion and high completion times, indicating friction in photo setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Display Experience Clarification: Update headline and body copy on the initial story screen to explicitly describe that pets roam live on top of desktop windows. (why: Choose path median time is short (8s) but mean time is long (514s), and support receives tickets from users confused about desktop overlay behavior.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Spotlight Layout Sign In Redesign: Switch the sign_in screen to a spotlight layout that focuses attention on fast social sign-in options. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9%, and support received reports of the sign-in screen failing or stalling.)
6: [home, notification] Ready Notification Option During Wait: Enable system desktop notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted as soon as pet generation completes. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, suggesting users minimize the app during generation and get distracted.)

scores.note: High support evidence (8 emails) and config-level change targeting sign-in drop-off.
Targeting largest funnel bottleneck, but requires new screen release and adds flow length.
Addresses extreme wait times (2336s mean) with high-confidence feedback UI.
Adoption is major bottleneck, but adoption redesigns previously showed no positive effect.
Simple copy fix addressing specific support confusion with minimal effort.
Sign-in step drops 27%, but prior sign-in layout/reorder tests showed minimal impact.
Config toggle for desktop notification mitigates multi-minute background waiting drop-off.
